summary: You take the preparatory economics and psychology courses, the policy core, an ethics course, the WIM, the capstone and one concentration of 15 letter-graded units, for 60 units, each with a C- or better. Core, ethics, WIM, capstone and concentration courses and PUBLPOL 50 or ECON 50 must be letter graded; at most 10 preparatory units may be CR/NC, and at most 5 of them in ECON 102A and 102B. Variable-unit courses count for 5 units (PUBLPOL 50, PSYCH 138), and CSRE 126C, ETHICSOC 135F and PUBLPOL 134 on its own need 4 units for ethics. Your concentration form's approval, the self-designed concentration, and the honors GPA and thesis are checked by hand.
